modules_implemented.pullDelta: Delta streaming engine with device authorization, negative cursor protection, monotonic journal_seq ordering, bounded limit (default 50, max 200), pagination-safe next_cursor calculation, and domain entity hydration
modules_implemented.hydrateDeltas: Domain entity hydrator packaging detailed records for assigned_cases, investigations, findings (with append-only revisions), and evidence
modules_implemented.getReadOnlyTopologyModel: Electrical network topology read model providing snapshot identity and element counts with hard-coded mutation_permitted = false
modules_implemented.verifyActiveDevice: Hardware identity sentinel validating registration and enforcing revocation lockouts
